problem: Six feature rows lacked automated native-parent evidence for public Office Add-in task-pane graph owners and inert MS-OWEXML custom-function metadata. The native corpus does not contain authored add-in task-pane graphs.
changes: Add nine integration tests across DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and XLSB, backed by a tracked shared assertion helper and thin adapters to each public host API. No production code, Cargo dependencies or fixture bytes changed.

Exercise the typed package lifecycle on ordinary and macro-enabled native parents, plus native Strict XLSX. Assert exact metadata fields, original data-part preservation and complete effective graph closure.

Test resource ownership refusals after prior valid staging, precise DOCX item limits, shared snapshot retention, stale patches and no-op publication. Reconcile only the six affected rows as partial coverage.

verification_scope.parents: Nine immutable native parents: Word visual DOCX and recorded-macro DOCM; PowerPoint media PPTX and passive-macro PPTM; Excel metadata XLSX, recorded-macro XLSM and Strict XLSX; binary Excel metadata XLSB and recorded-macro XLSB. Each begins without task panes.
verification_scope.metadata: Two explicitly library-authored panes preserve catalog IDs/versions/providers, an inert file-system fallback, binding IDs/kinds/app references, Unicode properties, visibility/dock/width/row/locking and frozen state. The first pane carries an inert external snapshot URL, opaque vendor XML, optional containsCustomFunctions with omitted val/effective false, a negative background state and Unicode/tab runtime/function IDs. Scalar updates change visibility/width/property/runtime data without losing other metadata or part/relationship identities.
verification_scope.snapshots: For the image-bearing native parent in each format, an existing PNG payload is copied into one new part shared by both added panes. Readers retain its exact bytes and path. Removing the first pane leaves the shared image; removing the complete graph removes the copied image and returns the archive to the original member catalog. Every original native image, body/worksheet/slide, macro and unrelated payload remains exact.
verification_scope.atomicity: After valid panes are staged, attempting to claim an existing native PNG part returns the precise shared Invalid ownership error, even with identical payload bytes. Earlier valid staging remains commit-ready and passes reopen/replay/inverse. A DOCM edit limited to two items rejects the third pane with Common(Limit { kind: Web(TaskPaneItems), maximum: 2, observed: 3 }) and publishes only the earlier two panes.
verification_scope.patches: Each lifecycle stage saves/reopens, replays and inverts. Equal graph replacement is an exact package no-op, stale patches return the host typed patch-conflict variant, and removing an already absent graph is a no-op. Original in-memory source serialization and on-disk native bytes remain unchanged.
verification_scope.comparison_contract: Generic DOCX resource replay may normalize [Content_Types].xml and _rels/.rels. Tests require exact archive member keys, every other member byte, every part content type, every part relationship and all root relationship values, including task-pane bindings. No whole-container ZIP byte identity is inferred. Private snapshot-resource vector order is not a semantic contract: every public pane/add-in/image/link field is compared explicitly at initial readback.
verification_scope.limits: The additions are library-authored derivatives, not native-authored add-in specimens. No fresh Office reopen/UI acceptance, remote catalog/provider access, file-system reference access, worksheet range-binding resolution, custom-function evaluation, macro execution or add-in activation is claimed. Shared custom-function storage on Word/PowerPoint does not establish native application behavior.

specification_evidence.finding: Typed properties, bindings, provider references, task panes and web-extension structures define the inert package metadata under test.

containsCustomFunctions val is optional with default false; background state is xsd:int; runtime/function IDs are XML strings. Tests distinguish omitted/default state, retain Unicode/whitespace values and keep all identifiers inert.

specification_evidence.reference: Shared web package ownership validation and public host task-pane APIs
specification_evidence.finding: The editor cannot claim a pre-existing part outside its replaced graph. The regression verifies that exact typed refusal and prior-staging preservation, without relaxing the ownership boundary.

coverage.accounting: Nine new indexed tests yield 558 indexed tests and 373 partial feature rows. Two UI-limited and four externally handed-off rows gain bounded operation evidence; missing native-authored add-in provenance remains explicit in every scope limit.
